summary: Adds support for analyzing and grouping or filtering billing data by project ancestry in Billing Reports and Cost breakdown reports using folders and organizations.
extended_definition: Adds support for analyzing and grouping or filtering billing data by project ancestry in Billing Reports and Cost breakdown reports using folders and organizations.

supporting_pages.title: "Analyze billing data and cost trends with Reports \_|\_ Cloud Billing \_\
evidence_snippets: As of January 1, 2022, the following data is available in the Cloud Billing reports: Project hierarchy : Project hierarchy is the project's ancestry, the resource hierarchy mapping of a project (Organization > Folder > Project).
Understand and analyze changes in project ancestry For the time range you're analyzing, it's possible for the same Project to be listed in more than one row in the report table.
The Cloud Billing reports don't support filtering or grouping by zone .
